board layer - named by the 3 overlays in dtbo.img

cards.title: ELI5: the chip, then the board
items: A device tree lists the hardware for the kernel
dt.img is the base: the SoC, no board parts
dtbo.img holds overlays that add the board parts
Both together describe the chip and what is around it

cards.title: In the base tree (dt.img)
items: 2x Cortex-A73 + 6x Cortex-A53, Mali GPU, ~2 GB RAM
Display, camera ISP, ABOX audio, video codecs
USB, MMC hosts, modem + GNSS RAM, SIM detect, FM
Power (PMU + ACPM) and the TEEGRIS secure world

cards.title: In the overlays (dtbo.img)
items: S2MPU08 PMIC on speedy, S2MPB03 and S2DPS01 chips
S2MU205 charger, fuel gauge, USB-PD; COD3035X codec
Himax touch, LIS2DS, GP2AP110S, grip sensor, NFC
Camera modules 4HA and 5E9; part roles are inferred

cards.title: Limits
items: Curated view; the 170-node table is in the appendix
Overlays name the SoC EXYNOS7884B; dt.img says exynos7885
The overlays turn on 19 of the 36 base-tree controllers
The bootloader may rewrite the memory nodes (unverified)
